mentions.name: Kamakiri Pages
mentions.description: A CLI-first static hosting service built after the author was unsatisfied with the available Japanese hosting options. AltStack.jp is planned to be switched over to it.
mentions.problem: The author didn't like any of the Japanese static hosting options and felt hosting a directory of Japanese alternatives on an American CDN was off.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I started building my own static hosting service: Kamakiri Pages [2]. It's CLI-first.
mentions.author: Xixi
